images.note: Real Snowflake sign-in screen, captured in Snowflake's own 'Getting Started' Quickstart right after the step describing following the trial registration email's URL and entering the username/password you set during signup.
Real Snowsight screenshot showing a brand-new worksheet with 'No Database selected' and the default COMPUTE_WH warehouse already active in the context bar — exactly what a first-time trial user sees.

imageNote: Checked whether Snowflake's marketing trial-signup form itself (trial.snowflake.com) has a Quickstart-hosted screenshot — it doesn't; the getting_started_with_snowflake Quickstart just links out to https://trial.snowflake.com as plain text and picks back up at the sign-in screen once you have an account. Used that real sign-in screenshot plus a real 'new worksheet with default warehouse' screenshot to illustrate this lab's actual first steps, rather than fabricating a signup-form mockup that doesn't exist in any real source.
